text:
Aisha K: hi all, trying to finish SSO/MFA but my YubiKey isn't being recognized on my Windows laptop. Okta keeps saying 'No security key found' when I try to add a WebAuthn factor. 1Password seat also still shows 'pending'. anyone seen this? :confused:
Raj (IT): hey @Aisha K — welcome! quick checks: 1) are you using a USB-A or USB-C key and do you have the right adapter? 2) which browser are you using (Edge/Chrome/Firefox)? some browsers prompt for permission.
Aisha K: USB-C key in a USB-C port on a company Surface Laptop 5. using Edge stable. tried Chrome too, same error.
it-bot: Account provisioning: user aisha@example.com created, device image IMG-SURF-0456.
Raj (IT): ok. two things: ensure Windows Hello for Business is enabled and the security key is allowed by policy. run `certutil -scinfo` and post output if you're comfortable. also try incognito window to rule out extensions.
Aisha K: ran `certutil -scinfo` — got "No smart card readers found". i can paste screenshot if needed: https://files.redwood.com/attachments/2087654321/certutil.png
Priya (Security): hi Aisha — we lock down legacy smartcard drivers but allow FIDO2 keys. if `certutil` shows none, it might still be fine because FIDO2 doesn't show as smartcard. can you open Edge -> Settings -> Privacy, search for "Security keys" and check hardware security key prompts? also try Settings -> Sign-in options -> Security key to see if Windows detects it.
Aisha K: Settings -> Security key says "No security keys detected". browser prompts nothing.
Raj (IT): hmmm. two likely culprits: USB power mode (Surface has selective suspend sometimes) or Group Policy blocking WebAuthn (rare). can you try: 1) plug key into a different USB-C port, 2) disable USB selective suspend: Control Panel -> Power Options -> Change plan settings -> Advanced -> USB settings -> USB selective suspend setting -> Disabled, then reboot.
Aisha K: tried other port and disabled selective suspend, rebooted, still nothing.
Raj (IT): ok escalating. I'm opening ticket IT-2218 and asking Security to check org policy. @Priya can you validate the Okta factor allowlist for Aisha's org unit?
Priya (Security): on it. also, for immediate access we can enable a temporary TOTP factor and manually provision 1Password. Raj, please create the TOTP secret and push 1Password seat.
DevEx-Bot: 1Password provisioning request queued for IT-2218.
Raj (IT): created IT-2218. ETA 45m. @Aisha i'll also ask you to try the YubiKey on a personal laptop if possible to rule out defective key. if it works elsewhere, we can reimage or adjust policy here.
Aisha K: i tested key on my personal MacBook and it enrolled in Okta fine. so key is good.
Priya (Security): thanks — that confirms device-side. looks like a policy block for Windows devices in your org unit. we'll update allowlist and push a policy change, should be quick. temporary TOTP enabled and 1Password seat provisioned. check 1Password app now.
Aisha K: confirmed 1Password seat active and TOTP works. re-testing WebAuthn in Edge — now prompt shows and key enrolled. amazing, thanks team! :tada:
Raj (IT): great. marking IT-2218 resolved. leaving a brief step doc in new-hires pinned: "Windows + Security Key troubleshooting" with our checklist. welcome aboard again! :wave:
